name: volt-review-loop
description: Run isolated review/fix loops for a branch until findings are resolved.

volt.description: Runs isolated review/fix loops for a branch until findings are resolved.

maxLoops.title: Maximum loops
maxLoops.description: Review/fix cycles /review-loop runs at most. A count in its arguments overrides it.

baseBranch.title: Base branch
baseBranch.description: Ref the branch diff is taken against. Unset: origin/HEAD, else origin/main, main, origin/master, or master. A base in the arguments overrides it.
